subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should captioned final TTS become a public channel capability that allows core dispatch to suppress and re-home visible text?
rationale: The capability is a clean plugin-agnostic alternative to hardcoding Telegram, but it creates a compatibility-sensitive extension contract whose incorrect use can silently change or lose message delivery.

options.title: Accept capability after proof
options.body: Keep the generic capability and merge after exact-head Telegram evidence covers normal, tagged, media, and fallback behavior.

options.title: Keep repair Telegram-owned
options.body: Implement the immediate churn fix in a Telegram-owned delivery seam and defer the public plugin contract until another channel requires it.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redesign this branch if core should not suppress visible text based on a plugin capability.

recommendation.title: Accept capability after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the generic capability and merge after exact-head Telegram evidence covers normal, tagged, media, and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history trail spans the core dispatch, plugin contract, and Telegram boundaries involved in this API decision.
